title: Direct Card Payment Amount on Buyer-Only Orders
content:
**Clause.** The direct card payment a buyer makes toward the plan premium of a Real Estate Service Contracts buyer-only order is worked out from the order's billing history.

1. **Premium still owed.** The plan invoices on the order less the plan-change credit memos on it less the payments the buyer has already made on the order, floored at zero.
2. **Direct card limit.** $400.00, less the card payments already taken on the order, floored at zero.
3. **Payment.** The buyer pays by card the lesser of the premium still owed and the direct card limit, rounded to the cent.

## Which entries count

| Quantity | Entries in the order's billing history |
|---|---|
| Plan invoices | every plan invoice on the order |
| Plan-change credit memos | credit memos whose credit reason is a plan change |
| Payments the buyer has already made | payments whose payer is the buyer, by any method |
| Card payments already taken | payments made by card, whoever the payer |

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders)

1. An earlier plan invoice of $545.00 credited by a plan-change credit memo of $545.00, and an open plan invoice of $650.00; no payment yet. Premium still owed: $650.00. Direct card limit: $400.00. Payment: **$400.00**.
2. One plan invoice of $650.00 and an earlier buyer card payment of $300.00. Premium still owed: $350.00. Direct card limit: $400.00 less $300.00, that is $100.00. Payment: **$100.00**.
3. One plan invoice of $445.00 and an earlier buyer payment of $200.00 by bank transfer. Premium still owed: $245.00. Direct card limit: $400.00. Payment: **$245.00**.
